# sv

Everything you need to build a Svelte project, powered by [`sv`](https://github.com/sveltejs/cli).

## Creating a project

If you're seeing this, you've probably already done this step. Congrats!

```sh
# create a new project
pnpx sv create my-app
```

To recreate this project with the same configuration:

```sh
# recreate this project
pnpx sv create --template minimal --types ts --add playwright vitest="usages:unit,component" --install pnpm .
```

## Developing

Once you've created a project and installed dependencies with `npm install` (or `pnpm install` or `yarn`), start a development server:

```sh
npm run dev

# or start the server and open the app in a new browser tab
npm run dev -- --open
```

## Building

To create a production version of your app:

```sh
npm run build
```

You can preview the production build with `npm run preview`.

> To deploy your app, you may need to install an [adapter](https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/adapters) for your target environment.

file.content: # Rocketbase Development Instructions > **Package manager**: Use **pnpm** only. Never use npm or yarn. ## Project Overview **Rocketbase** is a TypeScript/Node.js CLI tool that rapidly scaffolds production-ready full-stack applications using **PocketBase** (backend) and **SvelteKit** (frontend). It automates the entire setup process from dependency installation to development environment configuration. ### Project Goals - **Zero-config setup**: Production-ready PocketBase + SvelteKit app in minutes - **Best practices**: Modern tooling, type safety, and excellent developer experience - **Platform-aware**: Auto-detect and install correct PocketBase binary for user's platform - **Interactive**: Guide users through setup with prompts and progress indicators - **Git-ready**: Initialize repository and create first commit automatically ### Repository Structure - `cli/` — CLI source code (TypeScript/Node.js) - `template/` — SvelteKit project template (source of truth for scaffolded projects) - `.github/` — CI/CD and documentation **Critical Rule:** Never build routes/components directly in generated projects. Build them in `template/`, then the CLI copies them into new projects. --- ## Issue Tracking with Beans This project uses the `beans` CLI (Beans) for issue tracking. All work should be tracked using Beans and the `.beans/` directory. ### Mandatory Beans + Commits Policy **Every feature, bug fix, chore, refactor, or documentation change MUST:** 1. **Create a beans issue first** (or link to an existing one) 2. **Move it to in_progress** before coding 3. **Close it with a descriptive reason** when done 4. **Create a commit** that includes the bean ID in the message **No exceptions.** If you cannot use beans or create a commit, stop and ask the user to decide how to proceed. ### Quick Reference ```bash beans init # Initialize Beans in this repository beans list # List available beans (work) beans show # View bean details beans update # Update a bean's properties (e.g. mark in_progress) beans create "..." # Create a new bean beans prime # Output agent instructions / sync context for coding agents ``` ### Workflow 1. **Find work**: `beans list` 2. **Claim work**: `beans update ` (set status or add an assignee as needed) 3. **Read details**: `beans show ` 4. **Implement**: Build the feature/fix 5. **Close bean**: `beans update ` (set status=done or archive) 6. **Commit**: `git commit -m "feat: add feature X (bean-)"` 7. **Prime agents / push**: run `beans prime`, then commit and push the `.beans/` directory so agents see changes ### Example Sequence (Required) ```bash beans create "Add 2FA opt-in toggle" beans update --set status=in_progress beans show # implement changes beans update --set status=done git add .beans && git commit -m "feat: add 2FA opt-in toggle (bean-)" beans prime ``` ### Landing the Plane (Session Completion) **When ending a work session**, you MUST complete ALL steps below. Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds. **MANDATORY WORKFLOW:** 1. Run quality gates (if code changed): ```bash pnpm lint pnpm test cd cli && pnpm build cd template && pnpm build ``` 1. Update issue status — close finished work, update in-progress items. 1. PUSH TO REMOTE — This is MANDATORY: ```bash git pull --rebase beans prime # refresh agent context / prime payloads git add .beans git commit -m "chore: update beans" git push git status # MUST show "up to date with origin" ``` 1. Clean up — clear stashes, prune remote branches. 1. Verify — all changes committed AND pushed. **CRITICAL RULES:** - Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds. - NEVER stop before pushing — that leaves work stranded locally. - NEVER say "ready to push when you are" — YOU must push. - If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds. The CLI tool (in `cli/`) is the scaffolding engine that creates new Rocketbase projects. ### Toolchain - **oxlint** / **oxfmt** — Fast linting and formatting - **vitest** — Unit testing - **consola** — Beautiful logging - **execa** — Process execution - **prompts** — Interactive user input - **ora** — Progress spinners ### Run CLI in development ```bash cd cli tsx src/index.ts ``` ### Watch mode ```bash tsx watch src/index.ts ``` ### Build for production ```bash pnpm build ``` ### Lint and format ```bash pnpm lint pnpm lint:fix ``` ### Test ```bash pnpm test pnpm test:watch ``` ### CLI Implementation Patterns **Always:** - Use **ora** for long-running tasks with spinners - Handle errors with clear messages and non-zero exit codes - Validate all user inputs - Test platform-specific code on macOS, Linux, and Windows **Example:** ```typescript import consola from "consola"; import { execa } from "execa"; import prompts from "prompts"; import ora from "ora"; // User input const response = await prompts({ type: "text", name: "projectName", message: "What would you like to name your project?", initial: "my-app", }); // Long-running task const spinner = ora("Installing dependencies...").start(); try { await execa("pnpm", ["install"], { cwd: projectPath }); spinner.succeed("Dependencies installed"); } ``` The template (in `template/`) is the **source of truth** for all scaffolded projects. The CLI copies these files and applies final configuration. ### Tech Stack **Core Framework:** - **SvelteKit** - Full-stack web framework with SSR, file-based routing, and API routes - **TypeScript** - Type-safe development - **Vite** - Fast build tool **Backend:** - **PocketBase** - Embedded backend with SQLite, real-time subscriptions, auth, and file storage - **pocketbase-typegen** - Generate TypeScript types from PocketBase schema **UI & Styling:** - **Tailwind CSS** - Utility-first CSS framework - **shadcn-svelte** - Copy-paste component library (neutral base color) - **@lucide/svelte** - Icon library - **tailwindcss-animate** - Animation utilities - **@tailwindcss/forms** - Better form styling - **@tailwindcss/typography** - Prose styling - **@tailwindcss/aspect-ratio** - Aspect ratio utilities **Forms & Validation:** - **zod** - Schema validation - **sveltekit-superforms** - Form handling with validation - **@formkit/tempo** - Date/time utilities **Utilities:** - **radashi** - Modern utility library (Lodash alternative) - **consola** - Beautiful logging - **cookie** - Cookie parsing - **sveltekit-helmet** - SEO meta tags **SVG Support:** - **@poppa/sveltekit-svg** - Import SVGs as components **Testing:** - **vitest** - Unit testing - **playwright** - E2E testing **Development Tools:** - **oxlint** - Fast Rust-based linter - **oxfmt** - Fast Rust-based formatter - **oxlint-tsgolint** - TypeScript-specific lint rules ### Template File Structure ````txt app/ ├── src/ │ ├── lib/ │ │ ├── components/ui/ # shadcn-svelte components │ │ ├── +page.svelte # Home page │ │ ├── +layout.svelte # Root layout │ │ └── api/ ├── tests/ # Vitest and playwright tests ├── package.json db/ ├── pb_data/ # PocketBase data (git-ignored) ├── pb_hooks/ # PocketBase hooks ├── pb_migrations/ # PocketBase migrations sidecar/ # Supporting services including queue handler and email When rebuilding the template, use `pnpx sv create` with these choices: - **Template**: minimal - **Type checking**: TypeScript - **Add-ons**: - `devtools-json` - DevTools integration - `svelte-mcp` - MCP integration - `paraglide` - i18n - `playwright` - E2E testing - `tailwindcss` - CSS framework - `vitest` - Unit testing ### Required Configuration **1. Adapter Configuration** (`svelte.config.js`): ```javascript import adapter from "@sveltejs/adapter-node"; import { vitePreprocess } from "@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte"; export default { preprocess: vitePreprocess(), kit: { adapter: adapter(), }, }; ```` ```typescript import { sveltekit } from "@sveltejs/kit/vite"; import svg from "@poppa/sveltekit-svg"; import { defineConfig } from "vite"; { "onlyBuiltDependencies": [ "@tailwindcss/oxide", "core-js", { "scripts": { "dev": "vite dev", "build": "vite build", "preview": "vite preview", "test": "vitest", "test:watch": "vitest watch", "test:e2e": "playwright test", "check": "svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json", "check:watch": "svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch", "lint": "oxlint && oxfmt", "lint:fix": "oxlint --fix && oxfmt --write", "add-ui": "pnpx shadcn-svelte@latest add" } } ``` ### PocketBase Integration **1. Server-Only Client** (`src/lib/server/pocketbase.ts`): ```typescript import PocketBase from "pocketbase"; export const pb = new PocketBase("http://127.0.0.1:8090"); export function createPocketBaseClient(fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch) { return new PocketBase("http://127.0.0.1:8090", fetch); } ``` **2. API Proxy Route** (`src/routes/api/pb/[...path]/+server.ts`): This enables client-side PocketBase access through SvelteKit, handling auth cookies and avoiding CORS: ```typescript import type { RequestHandler } from "./$types"; const POCKETBASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8090"; export const GET: RequestHandler = async ({ params, request, cookies }) => { return proxyRequest("GET", params.path, request, cookies); }; export const POST: RequestHandler = async ({ params, request, cookies }) => { return proxyRequest("POST", params.path, request, cookies); }; export const PATCH: RequestHandler = async ({ params, request, cookies }) => { return proxyRequest("PATCH", params.path, request, cookies); }; export const DELETE: RequestHandler = async ({ params, request, cookies }) => { return proxyRequest("DELETE", params.path, request, cookies); }; async function proxyRequest( method: string, path: string, request: Request, cookies: any, ): Promise { const url = `${POCKETBASE_URL}/api/${path}`; const headers = new Headers(request.headers); // Forward auth cookie const authCookie = cookies.get("pb_auth"); if (authCookie) { headers.set("Authorization", authCookie); } const body = method !== "GET" ? await request.text() : undefined; const response = await fetch(url, { method, headers, body, }); return response; } ``` **Client-side usage:** ```typescript import PocketBase from "pocketbase"; const pb = new PocketBase("/api/pb"); const posts = await pb.collection("posts").getFullList(); ``` **3. - Handle errors with clear messages and non-zero exit codes
- Validate all user inputs

import consola from "consola";

  message: "What would you like to name your project?",

});

  spinner.succeed("Dependencies installed");
}
